name: Email History Backfill
status: reference only -- a one-time build run, never scheduled
description: Pulls the mailbox's history -- Inbox and Sent Items -- back to a chosen date, through exactly the same per-message chain the hourly Email Capture delta uses, so a backfilled Thread is indistinguishable from a live one. Walks BACKWARDS from the newest message, which matters to everything downstream: it appends older messages to the oldest end of conversations that already exist.
run: python run_full_capture.py --vault-path <vault> [--before <oldest received already captured, to resume>]

steps.name: Page backwards
steps.description: Fetches a page of messages older than the last one seen, until the target date.

steps.name: Same chain as the delta
steps.description: Classify, ingest, link the sender, rename the Thread, capture attachments -- per message.

notes: The hourly delta must NOT run at the same time: both write the same People notes. The delta launcher detects a running backfill and defers.
Enrichment can start before this finishes: its selector compares message COUNTS, so a Thread that grows at the oldest end is re-read.
Resumable: pass --before with the oldest `received` already in the vault.
